t: Tzire delatot muttar lehasir ulehachazir letzorek yom tob
s: Tzire delatot muttar lehasir ulehachazir letzorek yom tob ubo t' seipim: chanuyyot sheenan mechubbarim laqqarqa ella hen asuyin keen teba o migdal shel etz ukeshehu rotzeh liptoach hachanut mesalleq et haddelet veshometo legamre min hachanut — muttar lesalleqo beyom tob kede sheyyotzi tebalin mehachanut shehu tzarik lahen lesimchat yom tob. Veachar shennatal hattebalin muttar gam ken lehachazir haddelet uleqobo bachanut keshehaya, sheim lo nattir lo lehachazir — lo yirtzeh lepotcho, sheyyachush shemma yignebu, veyimmana missimchat yom tob. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehachanut omedet bemaqom sheyyesh lachush ligneba, abal im omedet bemaqom sheen lachush ligneba, kegon betok bayit hammishtammer — asur lehachazir haddelet lehachanut achar shessilleqo ushemato mimmennu legamre, kevan sheen bachazara zo tzorek simchat yom tob.

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh lehaddelet tzir echad bolet beemtza orko ukeshemmachazir et haddelet limqomo zeh hatztzir hu niknas letok chor shekkenegdo bimzuzot hachanut, abal im yesh lo tzirim (perush kol tzirim shebbimehem haynu shebbolet rosh echad mehaddelet lemala kemo yated verosh echad bolet mehaddelet kenegdo millematta ubammashqop haelyon haya chor shenniknnas letoko yated haelyon ubammiptan yesh chor shenniknas letoko yated hattachton) lemala ulematta — asur lehachaziro achar shennishmat legamre mehachanut apillu choshesh shello yignebu, gezera shemma yitqa et hatztzir betok choro bechozqa bemaqqabot vegarzen, venimtza metaqqen keli beyom tob, vechayyab mishshum makkeh bappattish o mishshum boneh, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch veshay"g veshay"d.

Veim en lo tzir kelal lo baemtza velo lemala ulematta, apillu hu omed bemaqom sheen lachush ligneba — muttar lehachaziro, shello aseru ella kesheyyesh lo tzir baemtza, gezera mishshum yesh lo tzir lemala ulematta, sheyyesh lachush shemma yitqa, ulepikak lo hittiru lehachazir ella bemaqom sheyyesh lachush limniat simchat yom tob, abal kesheen lo tzir kol iqqar — lo gazeru kelal.

Vekol zeh bachanut sheeno mechubbar laqqarqa, abal im hu mechubbar laqqarqa, apillu en laddelet ella tzir echad beemtzao — asur apillu lesalleqo legamre mechoro shebbachanut apillu letzorek simchat yom tob, veen tzarik lomar sheasur lehachaziro lechoro achar shennishmat mimmennu legamre, gezera mishshum yesh lo tzirim lemala ulematta, shehamsalleq tzirim hallalu min choram chayyab mishshum soter, vehammachaziram chayyab mishshum boneh apillu eno toqea bechozqa, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"g. Abal im en lo tzir kelal apillu beemtzao, im hu asuy liptoach velinol tadir, dehaynu sheeno asuy leqiyyum shello lepotcho raq leittim rechoqim ella darko liptoach velinol bekol yom — dino keillu eno mechubbar laqqarqa, shemmuttar lesalleq haddelet legamre mehachanut. Umuttar lehachaziro apillu hu omed betok bayit hammishtammer, veal derek shennitbaer besimman sh"ch veshay"g veshat"v leinyan shabbat, ayyen sham.

Kelim shehem meputztzalim, kegon menora shel chulyot vekisse veshulchan, shehem chatikot chatikot, vekos shehu peraqim peraqim — muttar lehaamidan beyom tob, ubilbad shello yitqa, dehaynu shello yechabberem bechozeq ugebura, shello yitchayyeb mishshum boneh o mishshum makkeh bappattish. Abal kesheeno toqea bechozeq — muttar*umah sheaseru lehachazir delet sheyyesh bo tzirim lemala ulematta, haynu lepi sheshsham qarob hu meod litqoa mippene hatztzir shehu lemala ulematta, mah sheen ken kan., Ap al pi shebbekol hashshana darkan lihyot tequin bechozeq — en chosheshin shemma yitqa gam hayyom kemo shechosheshin beshabbat kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"g vera"t, lepi sheyyom tob qal mishshabbat, lepikak lo gazeru bo kol kak.

Nokri shehebi ketab leyisrael beyom tob vehu chatum — muttar hayyisrael lepotcho beatzmo, sheen issur setira shayyak bekelim, veap al pi shebbeshabbat asur middibre soperim kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"z, mikkol maqom beyom tob lo hechemiru kol kak. Vehu sheen bachotam lo tzura velo otiyyot, deaz yesh issur mishshum mocheq, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"m ayyen sham.
Lehattir ulehapqia velachtok chotamot shebbakkelim veshebbaqqarqa uleshabber potechot shebbakkelim — kedinam beshabbat kak dinam beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"d ayyen sham.
Liqtom qash o qesam o teben o atze besamim, veken limlol atze besamim — kedinam beshabbat kak dinam beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"b ayyen sham.

Qematim sheosin hannashim bebatte zerootehen ubebatte shoqehen, veken haqqematim sheosin baanaq shebbetzavvar (sheqqorin qaln"r) — asur laasotan beyom tob, mippene shehu metaqqen keli. Vaapillu bechullo shel moed asur laasotan, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqm"a.
